+def test_old_keys_of_the_customer_are_removed(accounts):
+    _, conn, owner, source, target = accounts
+    one = Money.of("1.00", "EUR")
+    t0 = datetime.now(UTC)
+    ledger.transfer_once(
+        conn, owner, "old", source.id, target.id, one, now=t0 - timedelta(hours=25)
+    )
+    ledger.transfer_once(
+        conn, owner, "edge", source.id, target.id, one, now=t0 - timedelta(hours=24)
+    )
+    ledger.transfer_once(conn, owner, "new", source.id, target.id, one)
+    keys = {
+        row[0]
+        for row in conn.execute("SELECT key FROM idempotency_keys WHERE customer_id = ?", (owner,))
+    }
+    assert keys == {"edge", "new"}
